latestVersion.changelog:
Instagram Video Editor skill initial release.

- Instantly edit and export Instagram-ready videos up to 500MB (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM)
- AI-powered: describe your edit (“cut to 30s, add transitions, sync music”) and get a 1080p MP4 back in seconds  
- Automatic session setup, secure anonymous tokens, and cloud GPU rendering
- Simple workflows: upload, edit, preview, export, and download—all optimized for Instagram Reels and feed posts
- Handles video, audio, and text overlays; smart prompt-to-action routing for common editing tasks
- Built-in error handling for uploads, credits, and export issues with clear user feedback
